title: Tarot card positions and what they change
description: In a tarot spread, each position asks its own question. See how the same card changes meaning from past to present to advice, and how to read by position.

scenes.headline: Tarot card positions and what they change
scenes.caption: Where a card lands in a tarot spread decides which question it answers, so the same card can read differently each time.
scenes.vo: Where a card lands in a tarot spread decides which question it answers, so the same card can read differently each time.

scenes.headline: What a position is
scenes.caption: A position is a named place in a spread. A three-card spread might have positions called past, present and next.
scenes.vo: What a position is. A position is a named place in a spread. A three-card spread might have positions called past, present and next.

scenes.headline: One card, three positions
scenes.caption: Take the Three of Swords, a card showing a heart pierced by three blades. Its general sense is sorrow or a painful truth.
scenes.vo: One card, three positions. Take the Three of Swords, a card showing a heart pierced by three blades. Its general sense is sorrow or a painful truth.
